mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_chat_message (session_id, sender_id, receiver_id, msg_type, content, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{msgType}, #{content}, IFNULL(#{isRead}, 0), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT m.message_id, m.session_id, m.sender_id, m.receiver_id, m.msg_type, m.content, m.file_url, m.is_read, m.read_time, m.created_at, u.nick_name AS sender_name, u.avatar AS sender_avatar FROM sys_chat_message m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY m.created_at ASC
